info.title: v2.returns.get_return_list
info.description: Use this api to get detail information of many return by shop id.

get.description: Use this api to get detail information of many return by shop id.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: create_time_from
parameters.description: The create_time_from and create_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the order create time). The create_time_from field is the starting date range. The maximum date range that may be specified with the create_time_from and create_time_to fields is 15 days.

parameters.name: create_time_to
parameters.description: The create_time_from and create_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the order create time). The create_time_from field is the starting date range. The maximum date range that may be specified with the create_time_from and create_time_to fields is 15 days.

parameters.name: negotiation_status
parameters.description: This is for filtering return request by counter status. See "Data Definition - NegotiationStatus"

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is 0. if data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: if many items are available to retrieve, you may need to call GetReturnList multiple times to retrieve all the data. Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Default is 40. Use the Pagination filters to control the maximum number of entries (<= 100) to retrieve per page (i.e., per call), the offset number to start next call. This integer value is usUed to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single ""page"" of data.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: seller_compensation_status
parameters.description: This is for filtering return request by compensation status. See "Data Definition - SellerCompensationStatus"

parameters.name: seller_proof_status
parameters.description: This is for filtering return request by proof status. See "Data Definition - SellerProofStatus"

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: This is for filtering return request by return status. See "Data Definition - ReturnStatus"

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: update_time_from
parameters.description: The update_time_from and update_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the last return updated time). The update_time_from field is the starting date range. The maximum date range that may be specified with the update_time_from and update_time_to fields is 15 days. update_time_from should be >= create_time_from

parameters.name: update_time_to
parameters.description: The update_time_from and update_time_to fields specify a date range for retrieving orders (based on the last return updated time). The update_time_from field is the starting date range. The maximum date range that may be specified with the update_time_from and update_time_to fields is 15 days. update_time_from should be >= create_time_from

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicates the original return reason submitted by the buyer when initiating the return request. Applicable values: See Data Definition- ReturnReason and Reassessed Request Reason. Note: There may be cases where Shopee Agent updates the return request with a "Reassessed Return Reason" after reviewing more details about the buyer's return request and potentially after requesting evidence from the seller. If the platform updates the return reason during this process, the reassessed outcome will be provided separately in the reassessed_request_reason field.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: text_reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Reason that buyer provide.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reassessed_request_reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicates the return reason reassessed by the platform as more suitable. There may be cases where Shopee Agent updates the return request with a "Reassessed Return Reason" after reviewing more details about the buyer's return request and potentially after requesting evidence from the seller. Applicable values: See Data Definition- ReturnReason and Reassessed Request Reason. If no reassessment has been made, the value will be NONE.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The serial number of return.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: update_time

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Enumerated type that defines the current status of the return. Applicable values: See Data Definition- ReturnStatus.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: due_date
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The last time seller deal with this return.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: tracking_number
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The tracking number assigned by the shipping carrier for item shipment.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: dispute_reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The reason of seller dispute return. While the return has been disputed, this field is useful. Applicable values: See Data Definition- ReturnDisputeReason.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: dispute_text_reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The reason that seller provide. While the return has been disputed, this field is useful.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Items to be sent back to seller. Can be either integrated/non-integrated.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: email
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Buyer's email, will be empty if it is a non-integrated return in TW region.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: portrait
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Buyer's portrait, will be empty if it is a non-integrated return in TW region.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: model_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Shopee's unique identifier for a variation of an item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Name of item in local language.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: images
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Image URLs of item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: amount
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Amount of this item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: item_price
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The price of item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_add_on_deal
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate if this item belongs to an addon deal.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_main_item
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate if this item is main item or sub item. True means main item, false means sub item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The unique identity of an addon deal.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: item_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The id of item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: item_sku

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: variation_sku
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The variation sku of item

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: order_sn
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_ship_due_date
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The due date for buyer to ship order.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_seller_due_date
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The due date for seller to deal with this return when buyer have shipped order.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: negotiation_status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Counter status. See "Data Definition - NegotiationStatus"

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: seller_proof_status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Proof status. See "Data Definition - SellerProofStatus"

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: seller_compensation_status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Compensation status. See "Data Definition - SellerCompensationStatus"

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_refund_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether the return is RRBOC (Return/Refund request raised before Order Complete) or RRAOC (Return/Refund request raised after Order Complete).

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_solution
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate the most updated solution of the Return/Refund request (NOTE: this is not the solution during negotiation). Applicable value: - 0: Return and Refund - 1: Refund Only

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_seller_arrange
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether the return_sn is using the “Seller Arrange” return method. This would only be True for TW and BR.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_shipping_proof_mandatory
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether uploading shipping proof is mandatory for seller to confirm "Arrange Pickup" when is_seller_arrange = true.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_refund_request_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate the type of return refund request, whether it is a Normal RR request, an In-transit RR request, and a Return on the Spot: 0: Normal RR (RR is raised by the buyer after delivery done / estimated delivery date) 1: In-transit RR (RR is raised by the buyer while item is still in-transit to buyer) 2: Return-on-the-Spot (RR is raised by the driver after buyer rejected parcel at delivery) For more details, see Data Definition- Return Refund Request Type.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: validation_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether seller or warehouse will expect to receive the return parcel from buyer and validate the condition of the parcel: - seller_validation - warehouse_validation For more details, see Data Definition- ValidationType.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_arrived_at_warehouse
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: [Only for validation_type = warehouse_validation] Indicates the parcel’s check-in status at the warehouse. This field helps sellers quickly determine whether the parcel has arrived at the warehouse or has been rejected. Applicable values: 1: Pending Inbound 2: Rejected 3: Inbound 4: Cancelled

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: follow_up_action_list
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: [Only for validation_type = warehouse_validation] Warehouse handling actions for each item in the parcel.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: item_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Unique identifier of the item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: model_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Unique identifier of the model under the item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: qty
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Quantity of items or models under the same current status.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: current_status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Current status for the item/model within the warehouse. Applicable values: 1：Dispose 2：Return to Seller 7：Received and Putaway 8：Return to Buyer 9：Shortage Note: Since Resell is currently applicable only to Failed Delivery parcels, the following values will not be returned for now, and will be returned once Resell becomes applicable to Return Refund parcels in the future: 3：Putaway for Resell 4：Resell Outbound 5：Resell Failed 6：Resell Exit

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: related_order_sn_list
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: List of order_sn generated from the Resell process. Returned only when current_status = 4 (Resell Outbound). Note: Since Resell is currently applicable only to Failed Delivery parcels, this field will remain empty for now, and valid values will be returned once Resell becomes applicable to Return Refund parcels in the future.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: resell_failed_next_step
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Next step after a Resell failure. Returned only when current_status = 5 (Resell Failed). Note: Since Resell is currently applicable only to Failed Delivery parcels, this field will remain empty for now, and valid values will be returned once Resell becomes applicable to Return Refund parcels in the future.
